# Supplemental dependency licenses

These texts fill license-file omissions in published crate archives. The notice generator includes them alongside the unmodified dependencies' own packaged licenses.

- **alloc-stdlib.txt**: BSD license from the alloc-no-stdlib 3.0.0 crate, the parent project of alloc-stdlib 0.3.0: https://github.com/dropbox/rust-alloc-no-stdlib
- **webview2-rs.txt**: MIT license from upstream revision edc2caf886175ccaebe86078c9cfe1ae2a187328: https://github.com/wravery/webview2-rs/blob/edc2caf886175ccaebe86078c9cfe1ae2a187328/LICENSE
- **selectors.txt**: MPL 2.0 license text from the SPDX license-list-data repository: https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data/blob/main/text/MPL-2.0.txt

The unmodified selectors 0.38.0 source, covered by MPL 2.0, is available at https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/selectors/0.38.0/download and its repository revision https://github.com/servo/stylo/tree/572ecba2d1600e7c3d490586692a209faf703baa/selectors . Editor, MD does not modify these covered files. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt identifies every bundled package's source version and contains its license text.
